MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expressions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expressions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expressions.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

5. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

6. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expressions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
